name: zrndr_span_occlusion_add_polygon
description: zRndr::SpanOcclusionAddPolygon appends a saved span-occluder polygon, copies the submitted vertices into the active slot, stores a count capped at eight vertices, and stops when the saved-polygon list is full.
known_limits: tier S verification remains blocked by source-shape/codegen drift in the saved-polygon append helper: the retained per-iteration slot-address spelling improves VC5SP3 byte drift, but the compare still differs in register/prologue and loop-addressing shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x490710 validates the saved-polygon count gate at seven entries, per-vertex x/y/z copy into 0x64-byte polygon slots, stored vertex-count clamp to eight, and saved-polygon count increment.
The native smoke verifies normal vertex copy, zero-vertex append, saved count increment, stored vertCount, and the full-list early return without modifying the sentinel slot.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x490710 (2026-06-16, local target zrndr_span_occlusion_add_polygon, vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs) fails with 55 unmasked mismatches, 20 relocation-masked bytes, 3 trimmed VC NOP bytes, BN size 109, VC5 size 112 after the retained per-iteration slot-address source-shape pass improved the prior 86-mismatch baseline.
